{{Quote|Imperial Knights! Save your Emperor!|Mohrgan Fel's command to three Imperial Knights, including the brown-haired individual|<ref name="Legacy 1" />}}
A [[Color/Legends|brown]]-haired '''Human''' was an [[Imperial Knight]] in the service of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] of the [[Fel Empire|Galactic Empire]] in [[130 ABY]]. When Fel's forces [[Battle of Caamas|defeated]] the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and won the [[Sith–Imperial War]], Fel's [[One Sith|Sith]] allies betrayed him. He discovered an impending [[Death/Legends|murder]] attempt on him by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]], and fled into [[Empire-in-exile|exile]] accordingly. Fel sent four Imperial Knights, including the brown-haired Knight, against Krayt to distract the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] while he fled; Krayt arrived at the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on the Empire's [[Planet/Legends|throneworld]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Attack on Emperor Fel|slew]] all four Knights, proclaiming himself the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of a [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|new Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|They'll expect me&mdash;and a contingent of Imperial Knights&mdash;to appear at the council&hellip;''"<br />"''I'll lead them&mdash;and your double.|Roan and Mohrgan Fel|<ref name="Legacy 8" />}}
[[File:Attackonemperorfel.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The brown-haired individual and three other Imperial Knights battle Darth Krayt.]]
In [[130 ABY]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] with [[Color/Legends|brown]] hair was a member of the [[Imperial Knight]]s,<ref name="Legacy 8" /> an order of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] loyal to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] of the [[Fel Empire|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], they were an agent of deception in a ruse orchestrated by Fel against the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]]. When the Empire [[Battle of Caamas|defeated]] the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and won the [[Sith–Imperial War]], Fel was informed by [[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]], the [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]], that his [[One Sith|Sith]] allies intended to betray him. [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Krayt planned to [[Death/Legends|murder]] Fel and seize the Imperial throne at an upcoming meeting of the Imperial [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Moff Council]]. Before Fel accordingly fled from the Imperial [[Planet/Legends|throneworld]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], he arranged for [[Roan Fel's double|his double]] to meet with Krayt in the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] and buy him [[Time/Legends|time]] to escape.<ref name="Legacy 8" />

Fel's cousin [[Mohrgan Fel|Mohrgan]], an Imperial Knight, volunteered to lead three other Knights against Krayt in order to promote the deception. At the meeting, the brown-haired Knight, Mohrgan, and [[Unidentified Imperial Knight 2|another]] [[Unidentified short-haired Imperial Knight|two Imperial Knights]] stood with the decoy [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]<ref name="Legacy 8" /> as he discussed the fallout of the war with six [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]]. The meeting was interrupted by Krayt and [[Darth Maladi|three]] [[Darth Nihl|of]] [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|his]] fellow [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]], and Krayt demanded Fel's life. Mohrgan called on his contingent to protect the Emperor, but Krayt ignited [[Jar'Kai/Legends|two]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and quickly [[Attack on Emperor Fel|slew]] them all despite their attempts at a defense. He then struck down the decoy Emperor and proclaimed himself the Emperor of a [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|new Empire]]. Fel and the remaining Imperial Knights were forced into [[Empire-in-exile|exile]].<ref name="Legacy 1" /><ref name="Legacy 8" />

==Powers and abilities==
As an Imperial Knight, the brown-haired individual<ref name="Legacy 1" /><ref name="Legacy 8" /> was part of an order whose membership was limited to those who displayed potential in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The Imperial Knights were said to be among the most talented and dangerous Force-users in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="LECG" /> At Roan Fel's behest, the Imperial Knights did not participate in the Sith&ndash;Imperial War;<ref name="Legacy 8" /> the brown-haired Knight did see battle with a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], however, just after the war's end. They and three of their brethren were quickly dispatched by Darth Krayt's dual lightsabers.<ref name="Legacy 1" /><ref name="Legacy 8" />

==Behind the scenes==
The brown-haired Imperial Knight was introduced in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''{{'s}} [[Legacy (2006) 1|first issue]] ([[2006]]). The issue was written by [[John Ostrander]] and penciled by [[Jan Duursema]].<ref name="Legacy 1" />
